evidence.title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning

summary: Researchers introduced Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a novel training framework that enables agents to evaluate and refine their own decisions over extended horizons. Benchmarks demonstrate that SRPO markedly improves performance on complex reasoning tasks compared to previous approaches.
title: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization Enhances Long-Horizon Reasoning in AI Agents
